title: Research: group B native residual widths under #2979 joint W (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded independent-moment audit under priority revision 6 for #2979 group B. `research/rank7-group-a-entrance-audit/` already binds group A's native residuals (`0:261` / `115:261`). The deferred soft-overlap tip `f795116d` (`research/rank7-group-b-single-control-audit/`) reprinted registered guide margins and left native residual binding open.

This package binds group B helpers `{299,448,449,484,485}` under shared `W=⟨256,128,64,34,17,11,4⟩` on both providers and both orientations:

- helper 299: residual pair `0:260`, cold entrance, width **7**
- helpers 448/449/484/485: residual pair `114:260`, entrance `[51]`, width **6**
- adapter and `LOCAL-CHECKS` hashes match retained `FULL-NATIVE-RECEIPT.json`
- widths join all **3330** T74 fill placements

**Scoped native/interface audit. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Guide margins `+42541` / single-299 `−58943` are deliberately not headlined (already in `#2979` `STAGE-PRICES.json` / joint-frame / group-A).

## Result

Package: `research/rank7-group-b-native-widths-audit/`.
Tip: `24a291a502fc93e1bf7bdbb2d7b351ce75f0bee8`.
Content tip: `5241640244d2521818a6fe3b1f6c34e99d67a4e3`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/rank7-group-b-native-widths-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/rank7-group-b-native-widths-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/rank7-group-b-native-widths-audit/test_verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-group-b-native-widths-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_GROUP_B_NATIVE_WIDTHS providers=2 helpers=5 residual_widths=7,6,6,6,6 pairs=299:0:260,448:114:260,449:114:260,484:114:260,485:114:260 placements=3330 adapter_pinned both_orientations no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/rank7-group-b-native-widths-audit outcome=partial
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` / `require()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: `research/rank7-group-a-entrance-audit/` (native method; different helpers/W and pairs `0:261`/`115:261`); #2979 `research/rank7-joint-endframes/` @ `be191346…`; deferred `research/rank7-group-b-single-control-audit/` @ `f795116d` (margins OQ answered here). Does not reopen #3392, #3386, #3374, #3349, the #3259 cut, deferred V45, or the merged readout series through #2883.
